### Added
- `postgres.backup.*` in both charts: backups for the CNPG `Cluster` the connectivity chart renders, off by default. `method: plugin` (the default) wires the [Barman Cloud plugin](https://cloudnative-pg.io/plugin-barman-cloud/) — CNPG's supported object-store path since 1.26, the one the in-tree `barmanObjectStore` is deprecated in favour of — as the Cluster's WAL archiver and renders an `ObjectStore` (`<clusterName>-backup`: `destinationPath`, optional `endpointURL` for S3-compatible stores, exactly one credential source out of `s3.inheritFromIAMRole`, static S3 keys, `azure.inheritFromAzureAD`, an Azure connection string or account+key Secret references, gzip WAL/data compression, `retentionPolicy` default `30d`, sidecar resources) and a `ScheduledBackup` (`<clusterName>-scheduled`, default daily at 02:00 UTC, `immediate`, `backupOwnerReference: self`). `method: volumeSnapshot` renders `backup.volumeSnapshot` on the Cluster instead (no WAL archive). `serverName` overrides the folder in the store, `objectStore.existingName` reuses a store, `serviceAccount.annotations` binds the Cluster's ServiceAccount to a cloud identity (IRSA role, workload identity) for the sidecar. In the cilium flavor the CNPG policy gains egress for the store (DNS, `world` on `networkPolicy.ports`, the `cluster` entity for an in-cluster `endpointURL`, optional `fqdns` and `cidrs`). `postgres.backup.crossplane.*` (off) provisions the store the way the fleet provisions its own object storage: on `aws` an S3 `Bucket` with a lifecycle rule, a public-access block and a TLS-only policy plus an IAM `Role` whose trust policy names the cluster's IRSA OIDC provider for the Cluster's ServiceAccount and `<clusterName>-restore*` (scratch restore clusters), with `destinationPath`, `s3.inheritFromIAMRole` and the role annotation derived; on `azure` a Storage `Account`, a `Container`, a lifecycle `ManagementPolicy` and, on private installations, a `PrivateEndpoint` in the node subnet, with `destinationPath` and `azure.connectionString` derived from the Account's connection Secret (`<clusterName>-backup-store`). Bucket, Account and Container are never deleted by Crossplane and carry `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`. Guards fail the render on a missing or foreign `destinationPath`, zero or several credential sources, IRSA without a role annotation, a bad `method`, `retentionPolicy` or storage-account name, a snapshot method without a class and missing Crossplane inputs. `make verify-postgres` covers it; `ci/test-postgres-values.yaml` (MinIO shape), `ci/test-postgres-backup-aws-values.yaml` and `ci/test-postgres-backup-azure-values.yaml` render it. **No installation needs to act**, but every installation with `postgres.enabled` and no `postgres.backup` should: its Cluster now carries `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/backup: none` and NOTES warns that the PVCs are the only copy of the platform database. A CNPG Cluster without a backup still reports `ContinuousArchiving=True/ContinuousArchivingSuccess` — the operator's `wal-archive` command exits 0 when there is nowhere to archive to — so that condition is not a signal.
